name: inverted-shrug
instructions:
1. Position the safeties just below waist height in a rack.
2. Assume supine position on the ground just beneath the bar.
3. Inhale and reach up to grab the bar with a double overhand grip.
4. Pinch your shoulder blades together and exhale as you contract all of the musculature in your upper back.
5. Slowly lower back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
starting_position: 1. Position the safeties just below waist height in a rack. 2. Assume supine position on the ground just beneath the bar.
